ios.desc:
Paperparrot is an app designed to make organizing your documents easy and it's completely compatible with Paperless-ngx.

Features:
- Connect to multiple Paperless-ngx-Instances
- Add documents in various formats like PDF, JPEG, PNG, TXT or office documents
- Scan documents from right within Paperparrot using your phones camera or an Airscan-capable network scanner
- Secure your documents using Face-/Touch-ID
- Extensive search capabilities
- Support for Spotlight search to find documents from your home screen
- Create custom views to easily access sets of documents
- Share documents to Paperparrot from other apps
- Synchronize documents from your Paperless-ng(x) server to your device for offline access
- Built in support for push notifications from your server (additional setup required)*
- Dark mode!


* The free version of Paperparrot is limited to six documents and some features like custom queries and push notifications are unavailable.
These limitation can be removed through an in-app purchase. There is both a one-time purchase or an optional auto-renewing subscription (1 month free trial included).
The one-time purchase unlocks all current and future updates. With the subscription, all features are available for the duration of your subscription.
Both the subscription and one-time purchase can be shared with your family.


Paperparrot is licensed under the Apple standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
